description: ORBIT source registry: classification (development | research_candidate | authoritative), verification record, and licensing notes. A source is only promoted to authoritative with evidence. Verified 2026-08-17.

yahoo_chart_api.notes: Free, keyless, bulk-ish (one JSON per symbol, full history). Unofficial: no license for redistribution, data may contain errors. OHLC is split-adjusted (confirmed: AAPL 2014-06 close ~23.06 implies 7:1 split 2014 + 4:1 split 2020 applied). Use only to prove the pipeline; never promote to authoritative without a license review.
yahoo_chart_api.verification: downloaded AAPL 30y daily, 7705 bars, split/dividend events present (re-verified during Phase 3 final audit; prior check recorded 7547)

stooq_csv.notes: Bulk daily CSV, split-adjusted close. As of early 2026 programmatic downloads require an API key obtained via an on-site CAPTCHA; keyless automated access returned a JS verification challenge / Access denied on 2026-08-17. Connector implemented with key support; verify terms of use before any production use.
stooq_csv.verification: keyless request blocked (JS challenge + Access denied); key-gated per apis.io/community reports

sec_edgar_companyfacts.notes: Official SEC XBRL company facts, free, with filing metadata (accn, filed, fy, fp) for point-in-time reconstruction. Requires a declared User-Agent with contact; SEC asks <= 10 requests/second. Raw JSON is preserved verbatim; Phase 4 owns as-of logic.
sec_edgar_companyfacts.verification: AAPL companyfacts JSON downloaded: 503 us-gaap facts, filing metadata present

fred_csv.notes: Free keyless CSV per series. Delivers the latest published vintage only - NOT historical vintages. Missing values appear as '.' and are preserved as null, never filled.

alfred_vintages.notes: ALFRED is the archival vintage database Phase 4 needs. Programmatic CSV endpoint (alfred.stlouisfed.org/series/downloaddata) timed out from this machine on 2026-08-17; may require the free FRED API key. Connector attempts vintages only when explicitly requested.
alfred_vintages.verification: downloaddata?series_id=DFF timed out (60s x2); fredgraph.csv (latest vintage) works
